mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.device_id AS deviceId, r.ship_id AS shipId, r.reservation_no AS reservationNo, DATE_FORMAT(r.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(r.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endTime, r.status, r.estimated_cost AS estimatedCost, r.actual_cost AS actualCost, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(r.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.device_code AS deviceCode, d.location, s.ship_name AS shipName, DATE_FORMAT(u.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS usageStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(u.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS usageEndTime FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN device d ON r.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ship s ON r.ship_id = s.id LEFT JOIN usage_record u ON r.id = u.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.device_id AS deviceId, r.ship_id AS shipId, r.reservation_no AS reservationNo, DATE_FORMAT(r.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(r.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endTime, r.status, r.estimated_cost AS estimatedCost, r.actual_cost AS actualCost, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(r.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.device_code AS deviceCode, d.location, s.ship_name AS shipName, DATE_FORMAT(u.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS usageStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(u.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS usageEndTime FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN device d ON r.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ship s ON r.ship_id = s.id LEFT JOIN usage_record u ON r.id = u.reservation_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM reservation WHERE status = 'IN_USE'
